facts.did: 重返庞贝：气泡没有变小、也没有更缓慢地释放能量，最终更可能是一次大规模爆炸
facts.anchor: it was obvious that the gas bubble hadn’t diminished

facts.did: 告诉 Peristyle：Murtis 与 Curly 去年动身去了 Neapolis
facts.anchor: I heard they left last year for Neapolis.

facts.did: 带 Peristyle 去看 Murtis 刻在墙上当告别留言的“MURTIS * FELATRIS”——用正式碑铭格式、把 lupanar 的粗话改成头衔的自嘲
facts.anchor: was the legend MURTIS * FELATRIS. She had written it

facts.did: 转述 Murtis 的临别警告（山会像 Aetna 一样爆），但自己不信爆炸传闻，说“人生短暂，留在你爱的地方”而拒走
facts.anchor: She said it would blow up soon, like Aetna.

facts.did: 在 Neapolis 打听后找到 Murtis 与 Curly 所在的店：店名不叫 Julia’s taberna，而叫 the Milk Road（招牌是 Spigot 的壁画）
facts.anchor: No. It’s called the Milk Road.” He pointed up at the sky

facts.did: 拒绝谈论火山预兆：说已经三年却什么都没发生，请 Peristyle 别再说这种“疯话”
facts.anchor: it’s been three years and nothing has happened.

facts.did: 应 Murtis 之请做例行维护，同时从她体内取出三枚 director cells 装进加压样本容器（Murtis 同意，新细胞会长回来）
facts.anchor: extracted three director cells and put them in

facts.did: 回绝留满一整季，只答应留几周
facts.anchor: Not for the whole season. A few weeks.

relations.relation: 两人同在 Neapolis 经营这家店（店由 Murtis 和 Curly 打理）
relations.anchor: Julia’s taberna? It’s run by Murtis and Curly

relations.relation: 熟人：Hercules 与同伴去年夏天为 Murtis 办了告别派对
relations.anchor: we gave her a farewell party last summer

relations.relation: 恩主：Julia 让 Murtis 有了自己的店，且一直对她们很好
relations.anchor: my own shop, and Julia has been good to us.

relations.relation: 恋人重逢：Murtis 一见面就与 Peristyle 长吻（Peristyle 闻到情欲分子便沦陷）

numbers.fact: 距 Peristyle 上次造访庞贝已近三年
numbers.anchor: It had been nearly three years since her last visit.
